title: ITIL 4 Managing Professional - ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan, and Improve (DPI)
overview: The ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan, and Improve (DPI) course is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of how to direct, plan, and improve IT services and practices. This course focuses on integrating strategic planning with IT service management, improving service quality, and aligning IT services with organizational goals. It prepares participants for the DPI module of the ITIL 4 Managing Professional designation.
audience: IT managers and senior IT professionals.
Service managers and business leaders involved in strategic planning.
IT consultants and advisors responsible for service improvements.
Professionals seeking the ITIL 4 Managing Professional (MP) designation.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Comprehensive explanations of ITIL 4 DPI principles and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises and simulations to apply DPI concepts.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world scenarios and strategic planning challenges.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore strategic planning and improvement techniques.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of ITIL 4’s approach to directing, planning, and improving IT services.
To develop skills for creating and implementing effective strategic plans for IT services.
To prepare participants for the ITIL 4 Strategist: DPI certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for continuous improvement and alignment with organizational goals.
